items.title: Louis Nelson Interview, 1960-04-18
items.q: Well I played with him too.

ctx.x: Well just these around New Orleans, I forget the name of those bands, I say John Casimir. I don't know the name of his band, Eureka, isn't it? Young Tuxedo. Young Tuxedo and Poise Humphrey, he's Eureka, isn't it? Yeah, Eureka, yeah. That's the only two they have here I think, isn't it?
Well sometimes George Williams has had a band.

Well I played with him too. Dick Howard, different ones at times. Yeah, I played with Howard too, played with all of them, called himself one of the brass bands, played with all of them around there. You did mostly play for those clubs. Yeah, Mardi Gras. And Mardi Gras, well Mr. Bill I'm no young fella you see, and that walk was too much in that hot sun, I just couldn't make it too much.
